messages:
anshu: deploy-bot alerted on embed-service v2.4.0 showing spike in 5xxs in eu-west1. requesting expedited hotfix v2.4.1 rollout.

deploy-bot: automated alert: 2024-08-15T02:12:01Z - embed-service v2.4.0 error-rate 3.8% (eu-west1). suggested actions: patch or rollback.

ops-lead: tagged. need short changelog and rollback plan to approve express rollout.

anshu: changelog: 'Fix: retry window race causing intermittent 502s under burst'. no config/db changes. image built and scanned. link: https://internal.releases/embed/2.4.1

carol: docs ok with that snippet.

product: low user-visible change, +1 for expedite.

ops-lead: propose rollback criteria: (1) error-rate > 1% for 5m, or (2) p95 latency increase > 300ms for 5m. who will own watch?

sre-oncall: i'll own it. runbook: /runbooks/embed-hotfix-rollback.md. fallback: revert in-region or shift to eu-central.

anshu: starting express deploy: `/deploy release embed-service v2.4.1 --mode=express --ramp=8m`

deploy-bot: canary started (3 pods, eu-west1). awaiting 3 approvals to skip extended canary. metrics: https://metrics/embed/eu-west1/canary

carol: :thumbsup: docs attached.

product: :thumbsup:

ops-lead: :thumbsup: noted rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: approve_count=3/3. rolling 0->100% over 8m starting 2024-08-15T02:20:00Z.

sre-oncall: monitoring live. posting 2m snapshots. alerts enabled.

deploy-bot: ramp events: 25% @02:22, 50% @02:24, 75% @02:26, 100% @02:28.

sre-oncall: 02:24 snapshot: error-rate down to 0.4%, p95 stable. no rollback needed.

anshu: deploy complete: v2.4.1 at 100% (2024-08-15T02:28:10Z). publishing release note after watch window.

sre-oncall: entering 10m post-deploy watch; will rollback if thresholds breached. so far 12m and stable.

anshu: release notes posted: https://internal.releases/embed/2.4.1/notes

ops-lead: closing expedite window. follow-up ticket created RL-6012 to add test coverage for retry path.

anshu: thanks everyone, closing thread.
